questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a good way to reduce crashes when turning right?

options.text: Keep the back of your vehicle close to the curb.
Leave open space on your right side.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave open space on your right side.
questions.explanation: When turning right, do not turn too wide to the left. Keep the back of your vehicle close to the curb. Leaving space on your right side can make other drivers think you are turning left. They may try to pass you on your right.

questions.question: Where should a helper stand when you are backing up your vehicle?

options.text: In front of the passenger side
In front of the driver side
On the side of the truck
Near the back of the truck

questions.correctAnswerText: Near the back of the truck
questions.explanation: Your helper should stand near the back of the vehicle where you can see them. Before backing up, agree on hand signals with your helper. Create a signal that means "stop."

questions.question: ____ is a thin layer of ice that forms on road surfaces.
questions.explanation: Black ice is a thin, clear layer of ice on the road. You can see the road surface through it. A road with black ice looks like it is just wet. Be very careful when temperatures are below freezing and the road appears wet.

questions.question: The ____ trailer is most likely to tip over if you turn too quickly.
questions.explanation: When turning, steer gently and smoothly. Quick turns while pulling trailers are dangerous. The last trailer is most likely to roll over.

questions.question: What is a retarder?

options.text: A device that slows down a vehicle
A device that reduces engine noise
A device that improves fuel economy

questions.correctAnswerText: A device that slows down a vehicle
questions.explanation: Retarders help slow vehicles. They reduce how much drivers need to use the brakes.

questions.question: The trailer hand valve should be used:

options.text: To check if the trailer is connected to the truck.

questions.explanation: The trailer hand valve (also called the trolley valve or Johnson bar) controls the trailer brakes. Use it only to test the brakes. Using it while driving can cause a skid.

questions.question: Broken suspension parts:

options.text: Should be repaired, but not right away.

questions.explanation: The suspension system holds up the vehicle and its load. It keeps the axles in place. Check for broken or missing spring hangers, spring leaves, shock absorbers, u-bolts, and frame parts. Broken suspension parts are very dangerous.

questions.question: Cargo in a trailer:

options.text: Does not need to be secured.
Should be stacked no higher than three feet.
Should be tied down to prevent shifting.
Should have the heaviest items on top of lighter items.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be tied down to prevent shifting.
questions.explanation: Cargo must be secured so it does not move while the vehicle is in motion. Arrange cargo to keep the vehicle's center of gravity low and balanced.

questions.question: A smaller vehicle than yours:

options.text: Will usually stop faster than your vehicle.
Will usually take longer to stop than your vehicle.
Will take about the same time to stop as your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Will usually stop faster than your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Smaller vehicles can usually stop faster than larger vehicles. Remember this when deciding how far back to follow other vehicles.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should NOT:
questions.explanation: It is best not to drive in fog. If you must drive in fog, slow down. Use your low beam headlights and fog lights. Turn on your hazard lights.

questions.question: What can affect how far your vehicle travels before stopping?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on how fast you are driving, how heavy your vehicle is, and how slippery the road surface is.

questions.question: If you see an aggressive driver crash ahead, what should you do?

options.text: Pull over and yell at them.
Stop at a safe distance from the crash and tell police about the driver's behavior.
Block the driver in with your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop at a safe distance from the crash and tell police about the driver's behavior.
questions.explanation: If you see a crash involving an aggressive driver, stop safely away from the crash scene. Wait for police and tell them what aggressive behavior you saw.

questions.question: If corrosive materials leak in a trailer, how should the trailer be cleaned?
questions.explanation: Parts of a vehicle exposed to corrosive materials must be washed thoroughly with water.

questions.question: How can keeping cargo centered on a rig help?
questions.explanation: A rollover is more likely if cargo is loaded unevenly. Keep the load centered on the rig to help prevent rollovers.

questions.question: What is the rule about carrying liquids in a leaking tank?

options.text: It is acceptable if it is only for a short distance.
It is not dangerous if it is raining.
It is acceptable if you are running behind schedule.

questions.explanation: When inspecting a tank, check for leaks. Carrying any gas or liquid in a leaking tank is illegal.

questions.question: What should you do when driving through a work zone?

options.text: Steer with one hand to keep the other hand free.

questions.explanation: In work zones, follow posted speed limits. Slow down if road or weather conditions are bad. Slow down even more if workers are near the road.

questions.question: When checking the exhaust system, what should it be?
questions.explanation: Check that all parts of the exhaust system are tight and in good condition. Nothing should be loose, broken, or missing.

questions.question: When should you adjust your mirrors?

options.text: When a vehicle is stopped at a traffic signal

questions.explanation: Adjust mirrors before you start driving. Make sure any attached trailer is straight when you adjust the mirrors.

questions.question: If you notice an unusual noise or feeling while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Assume it is not a concern and continue driving.
Hope the vehicle is okay until another driver takes over.
Check it out to find the right solution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check it out to find the right solution.
questions.explanation: If you see, hear, smell, or feel something wrong while driving, have it checked out.

questions.question: What should you do if confronted by an aggressive driver?

options.text: Try to stay in their way.

questions.explanation: Get out of the aggressive driver's way if possible. Do not make eye contact, as this may provoke them. Ignore any hand gestures they make.
